projectDescription: A TypeScript monorepo that wires a local Ollama LLM as an outline-based risk filter into a Telegram trading-signal pipeline, with a 15-minute crontab for live channel ingestion and a full backtest harness to measure whether the LLM gate improves P&L.
keyFeatures: Local Ollama LLM (gpt-oss quantized) wired as an outline-based risk filter for Telegram trading signals
15-minute crontab for live Telegram channel ingestion via Cron.register from backtest-kit
Full backtest harness replaying historical signals against the LLM gate (January 2026: +52.22% → +68.90%)
Structured zod-validated LLM output: riskAction (skip/follow), sure_level, confidence, description, reasoning
Two empirical veto rules embedded in LLM system prompt: sleeping-coin SHORT and knife-catching LONG
MongoDB + Redis infrastructure for parsed signals and screened results
Telegram MTProto session auth via QR code (gram.js TelegramClient)
Dependency-injection container (di-factory) exposing services via globalThis.core
TypeScript monorepo with separate @pro/core and @pro/main packages built with Rollup
publicApiSurface: globalThis.core — IoC container exposing all services
globalThis.runRiskOutline(params: RiskOutlineParams) — standalone risk outline runner
globalThis.addExchangeSchema(schema: IExchangeSchema) — register exchange for backtest-kit
Cron.register({ name, handler, interval? }) — schedule live or one-shot cron handlers
RiskOutlineFormat (zod schema) — action | sure_level | confidence | description | reasoning
IScreenDto — fields: direction, entryFrom, entryTo, targets, stoploss, riskAction, riskSureLevel, riskConfidence, riskDescription, riskReasoning
IParserDto — fields: channel, messageId, publishedAt, symbol, direction, entry, targets, stoploss, visited
